mapper.select: SELECT r.group_id FROM rounds r INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id WHERE g.group_status = 'ONGOING' AND r.round_status = 'ONGOING' AND r.end_date = #{endDate} ORDER BY r.group_id
SELECT group_id, moim_account_id, user_id, round_cycle_days, group_status FROM `groups` WHERE group_id = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT round_id, group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status, created_at FROM rounds WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT round_id, group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status, created_at FROM rounds WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND round_status = 'ONGOING' AND end_date = #{endDate} ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rounds ( group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{roundNo}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{roundStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `groups` SET group_status = 'ONGOING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND group_status = 'RECRUITING'
mapper.select: SELECT gu.user_id, ( SELECT a.account_id FROM accounts a WHERE a.user_id = gu.user_id AND a.account_status IN ('INCOME', 'INOUTCOME') ORDER BY CASE a.account_status WHEN 'INCOME' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS account_id FROM group_users gu WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} AND gu.group_user_status IN ('PENDING_DEPOSIT', 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY gu.group_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO round_history ( round_id, user_id, account_id, moim_account_id, success_count, remaining_fail_pass_count ) VALUES ( #{roundId}, #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{moimAccountId}, #{successCount}, #{remainingFailPassCount} )
